meta.goal: Two Facebook Reels per day (10:30 and 18:30 Bangladesh time) from 2026-10-17 to 2026-11-11 to grow a brand-new page and bring owners to a free demo.
rules: English only, natural Bangladeshi English (see voice).
No links in captions or on screen. Contact is the phone number.

Facts only from the product docs and existing posts: price 1,000 BDT/month (regular 5,700), 2,500 BDT installation (refundable after one year), first month free after installation, yearly plan 2 months free.
No fake customers, no invented numbers, no fake testimonials. Characters and restaurants are fictional and must be labelled as such.
No emojis or Unicode symbol icons in text on screen.

Every reel must show the real DT Restora software on screen for at least 60 percent of its runtime. AI clips only add the human problem moment (max 6 s). If a viewer cannot tell it is a software ad, redo it.
Reels are 1080x1920, 22 to 33 seconds, captions burned in, first frame is the hook.

narrator.name: Ayesha (fictional narrator)
narrator.tone: warm, calm, confident, like a friendly consultant talking to an owner over tea

do: Use plain words: bill, cash, stock, profit, kitchen

dont: No slang overload, no Hindi or Urdu words
No real person's voice cloning or impersonation

tools.free_tool_notes: Free AI video tools change limits often and most add watermarks or cap length. Do not rely on them for 52 reels. Use them only as fallback.
risks: Face and outfit may change between AI clips; fix with the reference image and short clips
AI text rendering is bad; never ask for text in the clip
Daily generation limits on Grok and Meta AI may force batching or fewer SK reels
Meta may require the AI-generated label on realistic AI video
Reel scheduling in Business Suite is a different screen from post scheduling; the first reel will be a test

production_plan.phase_0_pilot: Produce 2 reels end to end: R001 (MG) and R002 (SK). Confirm quality, voice and the scheduling flow. Approve before batch work.
production_plan.phase_1_batch: Produce 6 days at a time (12 reels), schedule them, review in Meta, then continue.
production_plan.weekly_review: Every Sunday copy views, shares, messages and leads into each reel's performance; repeat the top 3 formats, drop the bottom 3.
